name: Mild amusement / fond bemusement

name: Affectionate resignation
interpersonalRelevance: Accepting that a partner has their signature ritual without letting it erode affection.

name: Sensory overload / acoustic weariness
interpersonalRelevance: Auditory fatigue caused by sudden high decibels, chewing, or loud calls.

name: Domestic asymmetry / chore fatigue
interpersonalRelevance: The feeling of noticing leftover heavy items or selective avoidance at the sink.

name: Playful incredulity / debate spark
interpersonalRelevance: The entertaining disbelief when partner makes a bold or absurd definitive claim.

name: Mild irritation / friction spark
interpersonalRelevance: Transient annoyance triggered by unexpected interruption, delay, or mess.

name: Frustration over repeated habits
interpersonalRelevance: Accumulated tension when a small friction recurs despite prior discussions.

name: Quiet disappointment / unmet bid
interpersonalRelevance: Feeling let down when a shared ritual, date, or expectation dissolves.

name: Relief and decompression
interpersonalRelevance: Comfort when a tension resolves into a gentle reframe or shared smile.

name: Feeling unheard or dismissed
interpersonalRelevance: Emotional distance arising when communication bids are tuned out.

name: Spontaneous gratitude and tenderness
interpersonalRelevance: Noticing quiet partner kindness or mutual accommodation.
